question: Which of the following is an example of a non-metallic mineral?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Limestone.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The minerals which do not hold any metallic elements in their** chemical configuration **are called **nonmetallic minerals**.
 
• These are the kind of minerals from which no new result can be constructed if they will undergo melting.Clay, diamond, mica, quartz, Limestone, etc. are certain samples of non-metallic minerals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Pyrite**, also known as iron pyrite or fool's gold, is **a naturally come out iron disulfide mineral. **
 
• **Hematite **naturally comes out in black to steel or silver-gray, brown to reddish-brown, or red colors. It is mined as a** key ore mineral of iron**.
 
• **Bauxite **is a sedimentary rock with a moderately high aluminium content. It is the world's chief origin of **aluminium and gallium**.
